599:t_009:63.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is exactly how humans ought to be.」

599:t_009:64.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And that goes for me as well...」

599:t_009:65.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$サルディアス$$...!」

599:t_010:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's more $$スフィア$$ power than ever before!」

599:t_010:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Yammering on about trivial nonsense...! What do you know about me!」

599:t_010:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's it. That is what I ask of you.」

599:t_010:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You slaughtered my subordinates before my very eyes. Your hatred must never be allowed to heal.」

599:t_010:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I knew it. Behind that show of loyalty, you saw me as nothing but a tool for using the $$スフィア$$.」

599:t_010:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We both treat people as less than people. That is why we can build a good relationship.」

599:t_010:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's the spirit, $$サルディアス$$. You really are worthy of being my adjutant.」

599:t_010:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I let you see an unsightly display, $c. But this is the only time.」

599:t_010:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And those of you who hold the power of the civilization of fire...」

599:t_010:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You are indeed on the road of $$シンカ$$. But you cannot go any further than this.」

599:t_010:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「One day you will be made to know despair! That time is coming soon!」

599:t_010:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Ha ha ha! We'll meet again, $$セツコ$$! If you can overcome despair, then I'll stake everything I have on facing you!」

599:t_010:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「By then... my hatred will surely have become something that burns everything to ashes!」

599:t_011:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The civilization of fire... $$シンカ$$...」

599:t_011:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I always figured that stuff was about Newtypes and Innovators, and had nothing to do with me, but...」

599:t_011:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You're too modest... Something different from those manifested powers is being drawn out of all of you by the power of the 'Gun' machines.」

599:t_011:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Though whether it blooms or not surely depends on what is happening over there.」

599:t_011:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What comes next is not something for someone like me to weigh in on. Please confirm it with your own eyes, Earthlings, and decide with your own will what to do.」

599:t_011:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now then... I wonder whether you can advance to the place that I and the people of many planets never reached...」

599:t_012:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That old guy! Talking all kind and helpful, and then leaving reinforcements as a parting gift!」

599:t_012:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「He's a slippery one, through and through!」

599:t_012:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But we have a reason we can't back down.」

599:t_012:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If, as $$サルディアス$$ says, our world enters its next stage when $$ラプラスの箱$$ is opened...」

599:t_012:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I want to see that with my own eyes.」

599:t_012:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I feel the same way.」

599:t_012:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「If our $$ガンバスター$$ is a power that guides the future, then I want to see what lies beyond it too.」

599:t_012:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes! I think we came to this world for that very reason.」

599:t_012:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm waiting, $$バナージ$$. For you to open the Box.」

599:t_012:11.en:
$$シン$$
「Until then, we'll handle those guys!」

599:t_013:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain! We're receiving video from $$メガラニカ$$!」

599:t_013:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Is this... what's happening inside that place!?」

599:t_013:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain! We have a response from Ensign $$リディ$$!」

599:t_013:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Patch it through to me!」

599:t_013:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, do you read me! This is $$オットー$$!」

599:t_013:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Come back! You're still a crew member of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$!」

599:t_014:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「So you did come here after all.」

599:t_014:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「There was nothing I could do... No, that's not right... There were so many other paths, and yet...」

599:t_014:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Captain... Why do you suppose the Federation feared $$ジオン$$ so much, and kept denying it...」

599:t_014:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「A band of devils who carried out the $$コロニー落とし$$... That is the result, not the beginning.」

599:t_014:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「The problem is $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

599:t_014:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「...'In the future, should the emergence of a new humanity adapted to space be recognized, those people shall be given priority in participating in the running of the government...'」

599:t_014:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「The prayer that was spoken at the birth of the $$宇宙世紀$$... turned into a curse the moment $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ put forward the $$ニュータイプ$$ theory.」

599:t_014:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「As if atoning for dumping the overgrown population in space... the first PM, $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, added a line about the future to the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter monument.」

599:t_014:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「But he was made a human sacrifice to the Federation's system of rule... The $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter was rewritten too, and that was supposed to be the end of it all...」

599:t_014:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「If only $$サイアム・ビスト$$, one of the terrorists who carried out the assassination... the $$ラプラス事件$$... had never gotten hold of the real monument, then...」

599:t_015:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...A promise of $$ニュータイプ$$ participation in the $$連邦政府$$... That is what $$ラプラスの箱$$ really is...」

599:t_015:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So it was as $$フロンタル$$ surmised after all.」

599:t_015:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Just that... That's all it was...」

599:t_015:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$ was a shrewd man. He threatened the government with the existence of the monument, but never made unreasonable demands.」

599:t_015:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「He contributed to the growth of $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$, then a rising company, and built up the $$ビスト財団$$...」

599:t_015:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「And so a symbiotic relationship with the Federation began...」

599:t_015:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「The original monument... A system maintained by keeping $$ラプラスの箱$$ reverently hidden away...」

599:t_015:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「It no longer matters what's inside. A box that symbolizes the order of the world, then.」

599:t_015:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「At first, it was no more than a scandal that could threaten the government of the day.」

599:t_015:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「But the rise of the $$ジオン公国$$ changed everything.」

599:t_015:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「Whether $$ニュータイプ$$s actually exist is not the issue. The very fact that the Federation buried that clause becomes the greatest weapon for those who revere $$ジオン$$.」

599:t_015:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「That is why the existence of the Box had to be kept secret. To keep this world from turning into hell.」

599:t_015:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But in the end, hell came anyway. A hell called the $$一年戦争$$.」

599:t_015:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「The scale of that sacrifice, and the existence of $$ニュータイプ$$s proven by the war, made the curse of the Box even heavier.」

599:t_015:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「That is why my old man and the others... $$クロノ$$, who would not allow the Spacenoids to exist, had to keep the secret.」

599:t_015:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「To deny them hope... a future, they maintained a warped system and chose a path where people are gradually tamed.」

599:t_015:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「And that is what kills possibility...」

599:t_015:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But you realized that mistake.」

599:t_015:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「...I was afraid... No matter how hard we struggled, I thought the future... fate could not be changed...」

kept_omissions: 599:t_010:10: Barbiel addresses 'those who hold the power of the civilization of fire' (Earthlings) - no omission issue; trailing clause left open as in Japanese.
599:t_012:1: Lockon's 食えない奴 subject (Sardias) restored only implicitly as 'He'.
uncertain: 599:t_011:2: ガン (in 'ガンの力') rendered as the 'Gun' machines, following 2085_05 t_009:40 (『ガン』の名を持つマシン); another slice may render it differently.
599:t_010:4: あなた (Barbiel) slaughtered Sardias's subordinates; hatred clause read as addressed to Barbiel, split into two sentences.
599:t_009:64: かくいう私も is trailing; rendered 'And that goes for me as well...' (I too forgot hatred / moved on), inferred from t_009:62-63.
Box: bare 箱 written 'the Box'; ラプラスの箱 uses its token, per earlier slices.
599:t_015:14: 親父 = 'my old man' (Riddhe's informal for his father/Federation elders).
